transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I… I came because something’s not right with me since my grandson was killed. My daughter sits right next to me, holds my hand, and I know I love her… but I can’t feel the warmth of it inside. Not the way I should.
Do you find yourself thinking about your grandson repeatedly since his death?

Yes… it comes back on me when I’m not meaning to think of it. I’ll be folding quilt squares, or just reaching for my tea, and suddenly I hear the shots again… and I see him there outside the community center, like it’s right in front of me.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time since your grandson's death?
I don’t know if I’d call it sad most of the time. I’m… not myself. That’s about all I can say.
Do you find pleasure in activities you used to enjoy before your grandson's death?
Not really. I mean… my daughter can sit right beside me and hold my hand, and I know I love her. I know that. But I don’t feel the warmth of it inside me like I used to. It’s just… not there.
How long have you been feeling this way since your grandson's death?
Since it happened… six days ago. Since he was killed outside the community center. It hasn’t really let up.
Do you feel guilty about your grandson's death?
I… I don’t really know. I keep turning it over, but I’m not sure what to say about guilt.
Are there any activities that you still find yourself looking forward to or enjoying since your grandson's death?
No… not really. Even when my daughter is right there holding my hand, I know I love her, but I don’t… feel it the way I should. There’s no warmth in it. So I can’t say I look forward to much.
Have you lost interest in things you used to care about since your grandson's death?
Yes… I suppose I have. Things I cared about just don’t reach me right now. Even my daughter sitting beside me, holding my hand… I know I love her, but I can’t feel the warmth of it inside.
Are you staying in bed for longer periods than you used to?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping track of that.
Do you find yourself moving more slowly or quickly than you used to?
I don’t know. I haven’t really paid attention to that. Maybe I’m just… doing less, but I couldn’t say if I’m slower or faster.
Do you feel like you could have done something to prevent your grandson's death?
I don’t know… I keep turning it over, but I can’t say. It’s hard to talk about.
Are you doing fewer things than you used to since your grandson's death?
Yes… I suppose I am. I haven’t gone back to my walking club, and I… I can’t seem to help with the repast planning, even though they’re counting on me.
Are you finding it harder to start or finish tasks that you normally would have done before your grandson's death?
Yes… it is. I just can’t seem to get myself started. I stopped going to my walking club, and with the repast planning… I know they need me, but I can’t bring myself to do it.
Are you enjoying anything at all since your grandson passed away?
No… not really. Even when my daughter sits with me and holds my hand, I know I love her… but I don’t feel that warmth inside like I should. It’s just… not there.
Do you feel like you're moving slowly or like it's an effort to do physical things?
I… I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed it that way. Things feel hard, but I don’t know if I’m moving slower.
Do you feel like it's an effort to do physical things?
I don’t really know. I mean… things feel heavy, but I can’t say if it’s physical effort exactly.
Do you feel like it's hard to get out of bed in the morning?
I don’t know… mornings are hard, but I can’t really tell if it’s getting out of bed itself or just… everything.
Do you feel like your body is moving slower than normal?
I haven’t really noticed that. I feel… off, but I don’t know if my body is actually moving slower.
Do you feel like your movements or reactions are slower than they used to be?
I’m not sure. I don’t really notice my reactions that way… maybe I’m just not paying attention.
Do you feel like you're resting or sitting still more often than you used to?
I don’t really know. I suppose I sit around some, but I haven’t been keeping track of whether it’s more than before.
